tasks.title: Align frontend IssueStatus enum with backend
tasks.description: Add Closed = 'closed' and Completed = 'completed' to the frontend IssueStatus enum in types.ts, matching the backend enum in packages/cli/src/types/index.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing IssueStatus values unchanged (Active, Paused, Blocked, Interrupted)
tasks.notes: No other files import IssueStatus by value — adding new enum members is backward compatible.

tasks.title: Rewrite IssueDetailPage Actions panel with Status-first logic
tasks.description: Replace the current scattered isDraft-based button conditions with a status-first switch in IssueDetailPage. Closed → Reopen, Completed → completion message only, Paused → Resume + Close, Blocked → Reopen + Close, Interrupted → Resume Pipeline + Close, Active+Draft → Start + Explore, Active+!Draft → Close. Also update statusBadge() to add Closed (gray) and Completed (green) branches, and add Closed/Completed visual labels to the page header status area.
acceptanceCriteria: Closed issue shows only Reopen button, no Start/Explore/Close
Closed+Draft issue does NOT show Start button
Completed issue shows completion text, no action buttons
Paused issue shows Resume + Close buttons
Blocked issue shows Reopen + Close buttons
Interrupted issue shows Resume Pipeline (orange) + Close buttons
Closed issue header shows gray Closed label
Completed issue header shows green Completed label
tasks.notes: Paused Resume reuses reopenMutation (api.reopenIssue). Design decision D4.

tasks.title: Fix IssueCard badge labels for Blocked/Closed/Completed/Paused
tasks.description: Fix IssueCard.tsx: change Blocked status badge from showing 'Closed' text to showing red 'Blocked' text. Add new conditionals for Closed (gray 'Closed'), Completed (green checkmark + 'Completed'), and keep Paused as-is. Remove the incorrect Blocked→Closed mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked status shows red 'Blocked' text, NOT gray 'Closed'
Interrupted status still shows resume button and orange text
tasks.notes: Independent of T-002 (different file), but both depend on T-001 (enum).
